run_einshape_tests: run the unittest test suite by discovering all *_test.py files in einshape/tests
build_einshape_package: build the einshape pip package using setuptools with find_packages and required dependencies
install_einshape_with_jax: install einshape with the jax extra to get jax>=0.1.71 as an additional dependency
install_einshape_with_tensorflow: install einshape with the tensorflow extra to get tensorflow>=1.8.0 as an additional dependency
review_einshape_dependencies: review the REQUIRED_PACKAGES and EXTRA_PACKAGES lists to understand dependency requirements for the einshape library
